build.buildCommand: npm ci && npx nx build web --prod

deploy.startCommand: cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && cp -r apps/web/public apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/public && node apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/server.js

_notes.env: HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 is required for Railway to expose the port correctly. Also set PORT (Railway provides it) and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL pointing to the API service.
_notes.standaloneLayout: In Nx monorepos, Next.js standalone output is nested at apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/server.js (not at apps/web/.next/standalone/server.js).
